capabilities: Toggle habit completions in an interactive weekly grid
Write completion checklists into daily notes as Markdown
Group habits under parent habits with per-habit weekday or interval schedules
Track streaks, consistency scores, and 28-day heatmaps per habit
Attach written or voice-recorded reflections categorized as good, bad, lesson, or idea
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an Obsidian core feature; it is a community plugin for habit tracking.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation via BRAT is documented for beta users.
motivation: The README says it is built around atomic habit building and identity transformation, keeping habit data local and private without databases, subscriptions, or cloud telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in habit tracking, so users must hand-edit daily notes or rely on external habit apps.

relations.evidence: If you use the Obsidian42 - BRAT plugin

summary: Habit tracker that renders a weekly completion grid in the sidebar, writes checkmarks to daily notes, and computes streak and consistency statistics.
